Comment FIVEADAY for your free 5 A Day counter 🥦

Your liver and kidneys already detox you, every day, for free. A juice cleanse mostly detoxes your bank account.

The habits that change how you look and feel are slow and boring, which is exactly why January plans fall apart. People try to change everything at once.

Number 7 is the real trick. One habit that lasts beats seven that last a week.

Are you doing a January reset this year?

Save this for New Year's Day, and send it to the friend planning a juice cleanse.
